product.title: SogesPower Multi-Function Power Tower Pull Up Bar Station Pull Up Dip Station for Home Gym, 10-Level Adjustable Height Pull Up Bar Stand Dip Bar Strength Training Workout Equipment
bullets: 10 ADJUSTABLE HEIGHTS- The height of the pull up bar station can be adjusted from 65.7” to 86.6”, achieving the perfect height for your exercises.This feature ensures versatility to meet the needs of users of different heights, making it ideal for individuals or families looking to enhance their strength training.

STURDY AND DURABLE- The pull up bar features reinforced steel tubing, making it more durable. The push-up bars are seamlessly integrated into the bottom steel tubing of the pull-up and dip station, improving stability and ensuring safety during workouts.The SogesPower Power Tower remains steady without any wobbling or shaking to ensure a safe and effective workout session.

MULTI-FUNCTION POWER TOWER- This dip station for your home gym supports a variety of exercise routines, including pull-ups, dips, chin-ups, push-up, knee raise,leg raises, and tricep dips.It helps you build triceps, chest, arm, back and shoulder muscles along with incredible upper body strength.Suitable for all fitness and strength-building workouts.

DESIGNED FOR COMFORT- The padded armrests and backrest of the pull up bar stand add an extra level of comfort during exercises like dips, making the workout experience more enjoyable and less strenuous on your joints.The dip bar features 2 levels of armrest adjustment, making it suitable for people with different arm lengths.

SPACE-SAVING- Maximize your home gym potential with our pull up bar station. The space-saving design allows you to reclaim valuable floor space, making it an ideal solution for those with limited workout areas. Transform any room into your personal fitness haven without compromising on functionality.
